sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay mechanics of 'Tangram Collect the cat' are straightforward yet engaging. Your goal is to create the silhouette of a cat by combining seven geometric shapes, each with its unique shape and properties. The shapes include squares, triangles, and rectangles, which can be rotated and arranged to form the cat silhouette. The game's controls are intuitive, allowing you to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. As you start a new level, you'll be presented with the seven shapes, and you must use them to create the cat silhouette within the given time limit.

The game features a variety of levels, each with its unique challenges and obstacles. Some levels may require you to create the cat silhouette using a specific number of shapes, while others may have time limits or specific restrictions on the shapes that can be used. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, requiring you to think creatively and develop new strategies to overcome the challenges.

One of the standout features of 'Tangram Collect the cat' is its ability to adapt to your playing style. The game adjusts the difficulty level based on your performance, ensuring that you're always challenged but not frustrated. This feature makes the game accessible to players of all skill levels, from beginners to experienced puzzle enthusiasts.

In addition to the standard levels, 'Tangram Collect the cat' features a variety of special levels, including bonus levels and challenge levels. These levels offer unique challenges and rewards, providing an added layer of excitement and replay value to the game.
